blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More senators are urging Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan to return to Beijing after the Chinese Embassy challenged Filipino lawmakers to declare the envoy persona non grata amid a diplomatic dispute over his remarks threatening the use of force against the Philippines.
